treatment.logline: A man refuses a price for his love, and the one who offered it is left with nothing to say.

arc.feeling: Respect arriving too late to say

treatment.approach: Locked-off and patient. The room is shown wide at the start and the end so the two men are small in it; the lens lengthens as the scene gets personal, the camera pushes in only on the faces, and nothing moves that is not moved by a feeling.

treatment.geography: Kasun is at the left end of the desk facing right, the father at the right end facing left, the window behind the camera's left. The camera stays on one side of the line between them for the whole scene.
treatment.key_image: The envelope alone on the long desk between two men.
advice: The father's silence at the end is written; if you want him to speak, that is a new line for you to write.
